title: security: RBAC v2 enforcement + audit logging + KMS region residency enforcement
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Enforce RBAC v2 policies across service boundaries, ensure audit logs capture KMS key usage and region residency decisions, and add a policy layer that prevents cross-region KMS usage when a customer has pinned residency requirements. This PR implements the enforcement surface, audit instrumentation, migration steps, and docs.

Summary of changes: consolidated the RBAC v2 enforcer, added region-residency checks to KMS integration, emitted structured audit events for enforcement hits and KMS key resolution, added a migration SQL to populate policy bindings for existing customers, added unit and integration tests, and updated docs and release notes.

Rollback/Compatibility: Enforcement is gated behind a feature flag (rbac_v2_enforce) per-tenant; default rollout plan is gradual with canary tenants. Audit logging and KMS residency checks are enabled in audit-only mode first to validate behaviour before full enforcement.

Related: ENG-4523 (RBAC v2 rollout plan), ENG-4899 (KMS residency requirements), SUP-1982 (customer support case referencing unexpected cross-region key usage).
commits: Init: add RBAC v2 enforcer skeleton and interfaces
kms: add region residency resolver and KMS key metadata caching
audit: emit structured events for rbac_enforce and kms_resolution
tests: add unit + integration tests for residency enforcement and audit events
review_comments: Priya Nair: Please add a migration rollback path and indicate the expected downtime for the migration. Also request explicit behaviour for missing KMS key metadata - fail closed or fallback?

Avery Chen: Added rollback SQL and migration notes in the PR description. Missing KMS metadata defaults to audit-only and is surfaced as a WARN; enforcement will fail closed only after 1 week of audit-only data and signoff.
Marcus Lee: Code looks good; please add an integration test that simulates multi-region customer requests and validates the policy enforcement metrics.
Avery Chen: Added integration test and updated rbac_metrics to emit enforcement_reason tags. CI reran and passed.
Jordan Kim: Minor nit: prefer explicit feature-flag check at the outer request handler rather than inside enforcer for performance. Approved after change.
Elena Garcia: Security scan OK, confirmed audit events include KMS key id, resolved region, tenant id, and enforcement decision. Approved.
release_notes: Enforced RBAC v2 at the request layer; added KMS region-residency checks; structured audit events for enforcement and KMS resolutions. Rollout gated by tenant feature flag and will start in audit-only mode.
